chronology.notes: P_Sequence model based on the IntCal13 calibration curve. The two dates at 418 cm were pooled a priori with the method of Ward & Wilson (1978).

site.sitedescription: Dry caldera located within the high-elevation belt of Gran Canaria. La Calderilla volcanic complex is located at uppermost peaks in the centre of Gran Canaria Island and it is composed of a strombolian cone and phreatomagmatic maar ~200 m in diameter. The site is located in a belt of Pinus canariensis forest.
